title: spec.json — requirements baseline (written once by the Planner)

complexity.description: Verification ceremony tier. trivial → fast-path (self-contract + build); standard → propose + auto-accept + build; complex → full adversarial negotiation. Absent/unknown defaults to complex.

verification.description: How pass/fail is decided. deterministic → read from data-*/DOM/computed CSS (can use a cheaper verdict model); visual → needs screenshot judgment. Absent/unknown defaults to visual.

examples.app: Notes — a minimal single-user notes web app

requirements.description: User can create a note; it appears in the notes list without a full page reload.

requirements.rationale: A notes app that forgets is useless.
